cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(KMGCCCAudioCodecs VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "x86_64")
    set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR x86_64)
elseif(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL "arm64")
    set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR arm64)
endif()
set(BUILD_PS3DRIVE OFF)
include("${DSD_SOURCE}/cmake/version.cmake")
set(_VERSION_TEMPLATE "${DSD_SOURCE}/include/version.h.in")
set(_GIT_COMMIT_HASH "b3f443d4c42ccf52806eb57def3b3a34805714bd")
set(_GIT_REPO_URL "https://github.com/wichers/dsd-nexus")
add_subdirectory("${DSD_SOURCE}/libs/libsautil" sautil)
add_subdirectory("${DSD_SOURCE}/libs/libsacd" sacd)
set(WAVPACK_BUILD_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WAVPACK_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(WAVPACK_ENABLE_DSD ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory("${WAVPACK_SOURCE}" wavpack)
add_library(kmg_audio SHARED AudioCodecs.cpp)
target_include_directories(kmg_audio PRIVATE "${FFMPEG_PREFIX}/include" "${WAVPACK_SOURCE}/include")
target_link_directories(kmg_audio PRIVATE "${FFMPEG_PREFIX}/lib")
target_link_libraries(kmg_audio PRIVATE libsacd_lite sautil wavpack avformat avcodec avutil swresample iconv)
target_compile_definitions(libsacd_lite PRIVATE LIBSACD_BUILDING)
set_target_properties(kmg_audio PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@loader_path" BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON INSTALL_RPATH "@loader_path")
